auth.label: Access Token
auth.description: Access Token used for PKULaw MCP Bearer authentication. Create one and enable MCP services at https://mcp.pkulaw.com/console/apps.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current PKULaw legal data tool with JSON arguments after checking its live schema.

serverId.description: The PKULaw MCP service to inspect or call.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the selected tool's inputSchema.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current PKULaw MCP tool.

result.description: The structured tool result, or its MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the PKULaw MCP tool.

actions.name: get_law_article
actions.description: Retrieve the authoritative text of a specific provision by law title and article number.

title.description: The Chinese title of the law or regulation.

number.description: The article number written in Chinese, such as 第一千零七十七条.

inputSchema.description: Input for retrieving one specific legal provision.

article.description: A result record returned by PKULaw.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current legal research tools and live input schemas exposed by one PKULaw MCP service.

serverId.description: The PKULaw MCP service to inspect or call.

inputSchema.description: Input for discovering one PKULaw MCP service.

serverId.description: The PKULaw MCP service to inspect or call.

displayName.description: The official display name of the selected PKULaw MCP service.

name.description: The exact PKULaw MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by PKULaw MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform destructive operations.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls are expected to be idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with entities outside PKULaw.

annotations.description: MCP hints supplied by PKULaw about a tool's behavior.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by PKULaw MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by one PKULaw MCP service.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed by the selected PKULaw service.

outputSchema.description: The current PKULaw MCP tool catalog for one service.

actions.name: search_case_documents
actions.description: Search detailed PKULaw judicial case records by title or full-text keywords.

title.description: A keyword to match against document titles.

fulltext.description: A keyword or phrase to match against document text.

inputSchema.description: Input for searching detailed judicial case records.

items.description: A result record returned by PKULaw.

outputSchema.description: Detailed judicial case records matching the supplied keywords.

actions.name: search_cases
actions.description: Search authoritative PKULaw judicial cases using a natural-language fact pattern.

text.description: A natural-language fact pattern or legal issue in Chinese.

inputSchema.description: Input for semantically searching judicial cases.

items.description: A result record returned by PKULaw.

cases.description: Matching judicial case records, ordered by relevance.

outputSchema.description: Judicial cases matching the fact pattern.

actions.name: search_law_articles
actions.description: Search authoritative PKULaw provisions using a natural-language legal question or fact pattern.

query.description: A natural-language legal question or fact pattern in Chinese.

inputSchema.description: Input for semantically searching legal provisions.

items.description: A result record returned by PKULaw.

articles.description: Matching legal provision records, ordered by relevance.

actions.name: search_laws
actions.description: Search PKULaw laws and regulations by title or full-text keywords.

title.description: A keyword to match against document titles.

fulltext.description: A keyword or phrase to match against document text.

inputSchema.description: Input for searching laws and regulations by keyword.

items.description: A result record returned by PKULaw.

outputSchema.description: Laws and regulations matching the supplied keywords.
